data.long_meaning: Sahin is a Hindu name that means warrior or lion. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sa-hin' which translates to 'with-army' or 'with-lions'. Parents who choose Sahin usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior, lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
